jsonLd.notes: VERIFIED 2026-10: product pages ship one application/ld+json block with @type Product. Fields: name, url, image (array, first = main), brand.name, offers[] (price, priceCurrency, availability). No category field - derive type from name keywords (see scraper.js TYPE_MAP).

selectors.name: h1.product__title
selectors.price: JSON-LD offers[0].price preferred; no reliable DOM selector

notes: Image srcs are protocol-relative (//us.brandymelville.com/...) - prepend https:.
URL pattern: https://us.brandymelville.com/products/{slug} - variant param optional, strip it for the canonical product URL.
No category/breadcrumb in DOM or JSON-LD: type must come from name keywords.
